integrity: A complete analytic proof and a standalone exact rational diagnostic checker are supplied. Novelty is assessed relative to inspected sources only. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Proved for integer p>=2, N>=2, 0<a<pi, and periodized sampled sinc-power circulants, not Toeplitz principal blocks. Exact crossover only in specified near-critical range. Earlier equivalent cyclic-spline calculations may be unindexed. Numerical and finite exact checks support but do not replace the full proof.
title: Exact odd-cycle Nyquist rescue and critical band-wrap crossover for periodized sinc powers
